entries.title: Green Hell

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the original full-release route and remains the highest-control capture/settings path. PS5 and Xbox Series X/S are strong current-gen routes with updates that brought over content formerly exclusive to PC, but they do not add sourced exclusive content beyond PC.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version through Steam for the most complete and flexible route. Use the native PS5 or Xbox Series X/S versions only if a console setup is preferred.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC full release with scalable settings and the earliest access to the complete content update path.
all_releases.reason: primary: original complete route and best capture/settings platform.
skip: portable route only, with no sourced exclusive content over PC.
skip: no sourced exclusive content over PC and no longer the best console-fidelity route after the PS5 version.
skip: no sourced exclusive content over PC and no longer the best console-fidelity route after the Xbox Series X/S version.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PS5 edition with the Green Hell experience and major content updates including Spirits of Amazonia.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong current-gen console route, but no sourced exclusive content over the PC version.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Xbox Series X/S edition with current-gen optimization, 4K Ultra HD support, and major content updates including Spirits of Amazonia.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong current-gen console route, but no sourced exclusive content over the PC version.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The PS5 and Xbox Series X/S versions improved the console completeness route by adding content previously available only on PC, but PC still combines the complete content path with the best capture/settings ceiling.

entries.remaster_caveats: The PS5 and Xbox Series X/S releases are current-gen ports/upgrades, not separate game entries. Older PS4 and Xbox One versions are explicitly behind the current-gen update path.
